test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

The captain as well as the entire crew __have reached__ the harbour safely.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "as well as" does not alter the number of the subject, which remains singular.
 
• Therefore, the verb should agree with the singular subject **"The captain"**.
 
• Hence, the correct verb form should be "has reached" instead of "have reached".

Hence, the correct statement is '*The captain as well as the entire crew **has reached** the harbour safely.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When the subject is followed by phrases such as "as well as", "along with", "together with", etc., the verb should agree with the main subject.
 
• If the** main subject is singular,** the **verb should be singular**.
 
 
• **Example:** *The teacher, along with the students, **is** going on a trip.*
 
 
 
• If the main subject is plural, the verb should be plural.
 
 
• Example: *The teachers, along with the principal, **are** attending the meeting.*
